observations: The page number «234» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 continues the sentence of p. [233] (JP2 0265, L26).

L08, L10, L20, L25 and L35: the formulas are displayed, each in a line of its own, centred; the fractions are built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, and in L32 the fraction «HP» over «HE» stands built up within the line. The indices of «Cα», «C90», «e1», «B90», «B96» and «Bα» are lowered, except in L26, where the α of «Bα» stands small on the line. Letters of the figures, e, m, r, α and ψ in italics; «sin aeq. anom. max.» (L28) in italics. «3½′» (L05) is printed with a fraction ¹/₂; «60p», «8p 58′», «6p 50′», «2p» with the p raised.

L13-L17. Checked: sin 8° 36′ = 0.14954, and 0.14954 · 60 = 8p 58.3′. Al-Khwārizmī's Saturn has the equation of the centre 8° 36′ at 90° (Tab. 29, p. 140, JP2 0172); 6p 50′ is the distance of Ptolemy's equant of Saturn from the earth, twice his eccentricity 3p 25′. L01-L05: checked for Saturn (Tab. 27-29, pp. 138-140, JP2 0170-0172): the equation of the centre of the table agrees with C90 · sin α and with arcsin (sin C90 · sin α), the formula of L01, within 1.4′ at 15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 75° and 90°, and between these arguments falls below them, by up to 4.5′ (the first, at 54°) and 4.2′ (the second, at 68° and 84°), Suter's 3½′-4′; the whole column agrees within 1.3′ (0.4′ on the average of the squares) with a linear interpolation of the second formula between its values at every 15°.

L28-L30: checked: al-Khwārizmī's Saturn has the greatest equation of the anomaly, 5° 44′, at the arguments 95° to 98° (Tab. 30, p. 141, JP2 0173), as Suter says. L31-L35: in the right triangle EHP the sine of the angle at E is HP : HE, the radius of the epicycle when HE = 1.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.’s» and «Pechüle’s» (L05), «Kh.» (L06, L12, L13, L15), «Ptol.» (L14, L22, L27, L29), «Ptol.-Batt.» (L16), «Pechüle» (L22); «Kh.» in L30 is not spaced. «giebt» (L14), in the older spelling, where p. [233] (JP2 0265, L08) has «gibt». Italics: «Anomalie» (L18).
